name: Standing Cable Chest Fly
cue: Inhale as your arms open wide. Exhale as you bring them together in front of your chest.

name: Standing Cable Chest Fly
cue: 3 seconds letting the arms open, 1 second squeeze as the hands meet. Never rushed.

name: Standing Cable Chest Fly
cue: Don't bend and straighten your elbows - that turns it into a press. Hold a soft fixed elbow and squeeze from the chest.
